sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.text_preview: D UAL-MODULUS prescalers are frequency dividers with two selectable divide ratios. They are widely used in frequency synthesizers to extend the frequency range of programmable dividers. Numerous prescalers for the mobile communications market in the frequency range of 1–2 GHz have been presented. They are manufactured in Si bipolar [1]–[3] or CMOS technology [4]–[9]. sections.text_preview: The prescalers consist of a synchronous divide-by-four/divide-by-five input stage followed by an asynchronous counter. sections.title: CONCLUSION
sections.text_preview: We have presented two dual-modulus prescalers in silicon bipolar technology. Both allow wide-band operation and operate with minimum supply voltages of 2.0 V and 2.7 V, respectively. One of the prescalers has been optimized for low-power operation at a maximum input frequency of 2 GHz.
